title: Spatial Transcriptomics Reveals HER2/AR-Associated Heterogeneity and Alternative Surface Targets in Salivary Duct Carcinoma.
snippet: Salivary duct carcinoma (SDC) is an aggressive malignancy primarily treated with human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)- and androgen receptor (AR)-directed therapies in the recurrent or metastatic setting, although therapeutic responses remain heterogeneous.
